mapper.select: SELECT A.SERVER_ID /* 서버ID */ , A.SERVER_NM /* 서버명 */ , A.REST_BASE_URL /* REST API BASE URL */ , A.DB_HOST /* 배치메타DB호스트 */ , A.DB_PORT /* 배치메타DB포트 */ , A.DB_NAME /* 배치메타DB명 */ , A.DB_USER /* 배치메타DB사용자 */ , A.DBMS_TYPE /* DBMS종류(MYSQL/POSTGRES) */ , A.USE_YN /* 사용여부 */ , A.DESCRIPTION /* 설명 */ , A.REG_DT /* 등록일시 */ , A.UPDATE_DT /* 수정일시 */ FROM TB_BATCH_SERVER A WHERE 1=1 AND A.SERVER_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{SERVER_NM}, '%') AND A.USE_YN = #{USE_YN} ORDER BY A.SERVER_ID

SELECT A.SERVER_ID , A.SERVER_NM , A.REST_BASE_URL , A.DB_HOST , A.DB_PORT , A.DB_NAME , A.DB_USER , A.DB_PASSWORD , A.DBMS_TYPE , A.USE_YN FROM TB_BATCH_SERVER A WHERE 1=1 AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY A.SERVER_ID

SELECT A.SERVER_ID , A.SERVER_NM , A.REST_BASE_URL , A.DB_HOST , A.DB_PORT , A.DB_NAME , A.DB_USER , A.DB_PASSWORD , A.DBMS_TYPE , A.USE_YN , A.DESCRIPTION , A.REG_DT , A.UPDATE_DT FROM TB_BATCH_SERVER A WHERE 1=1 AND A.SERVER_ID = #{serverId}
